key_insight: Introducing Agent-RRM, a multi-faceted reward model that gives structured, step-level feedback on agent reasoning and tool use, enabling denser and more informative rewards than sparse outcome-only signals. This improves credit assignment across intermediate reasoning steps and leads to better-trained agents.
problem_solved: Sparse, outcome-based rewards fail to distinguish the quality of intermediate reasoning or tool-using steps, causing suboptimal learning for agentic systems. Agent-RRM addresses the need for fine-grained, structured feedback during trajectory execution.
method: Design a multi-dimensional reward model (Agent-RRM) that scores trajectories with structured labels such as step-level reasoning quality, tool usage correctness, and plan coherence.
Use these structured scores as dense, intermediate rewards or shaping signals inside the agent training loop to improve credit assignment and learning dynamics.
Integrate Agent-RRM outputs into policy optimization (or evaluation) to prioritize high-quality reasoning traces and guide agents toward reliable tool use and coherent multi-step solutions.
impact: Provides practitioners a practical way to move beyond sparse outcome rewards, yielding faster and more robust training for agents that perform multi-step reasoning and tool use. Better intermediate-feedback enables safer, more interpretable agent behavior.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: agent generates trajectory → Agent-RRM scores each step → dense rewards fed back to agent trainer (RL loop).
Bar chart or heatmap: comparison of sparse outcome reward vs. Agent-RRM dense rewards across steps, showing improved signal coverage.
Example trace overlay: a short chain-of-thought annotated with per-step scores (reasoning quality, tool correctness, coherence).
Performance comparison: line chart showing learning curves (reward or task success) for baseline vs. Agent-RRM-enhanced agents.
paper_title: Exploring Reasoning Reward Model for Agents
paper_authors: Kaixuan Fan, Kaituo Feng, Manyuan Zhang, Tianshuo Peng, Zhixun Li
